Amit Shah Launches FCRA 2.0 Portal and e-OCI Card

Union Home Minister Amit Shah has launched the revamped Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) 2.0 portal and the digital Overseas Citizen of India (e-OCI) card. The new FCRA portal aims to enhance transparency and ease of governance for honest individuals by embracing technology. The launch is expected to boost real-time monitoring of foreign donations and improve digital governance.
